section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section provides a comprehensive theoretical background on body image research, emphasizing the shift from studying negative body image to positive body image constructs, particularly body appreciation. The authors discuss self-compassion (with its engagement and action subscales) and psychological flexibility as potential mechanisms related to body appreciation. The section concludes by stating the aims of 'the present study,' which will explore body appreciation among Portuguese women and test whether self-compassionate engagement and action differentially impact body appreciation, and whether psychological flexibility mediates the relationship between these constructs. However, no specific study methodology, sample characteristics, or empirical results are provided in this introduction section.
